## Indian Empire

Indian Empire may refer to:
* Maurya Empire (322 BCE – 185 BCE)
* Gupta Empire ( 240– 550)
* Chalukya Empire (543-753)
* Rashtrakuta Empire (753–982)
* Gurjara-Pratihara Empire (730-1036)
* Pala Empire (750–1161)
* Chola Empire (848–1279)
* Delhi Sultanate (1206–1526)
* Vijayanagara Empire (1336-1646)
* Mughal Empire (1526–1857)
* Sur Empire (1538–1555)
* Maratha Empire (1674–1818)
* Sikh Empire (1799-1849)
* British Raj (1858–1947)
